prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create a production game-animation BODY sprite sheet for the EXACT blue/silver/gold armored SX knight in input 1. Input 1 is the only approved complete character design; input 2 is an enlarged crop ONLY to clarify the original helmet, eye slits, cheek plates, and seamless head/neck/shoulder relationship. Do not redesign.

Four complete CONNECTED characters, clean 2 by 2 layout on genuine transparent RGBA. Aim 2048 by 2048 for detail. Each cell has generous transparent outer margins. Same adult body proportions and the SAME character scale in all cells, same front-right three-quarter camera. Full boots and all cape tips visible.

CRITICAL: Each head, neck, collar and shoulders is drawn as ONE anatomically coherent assembled character. Never remove the head, never show an exposed peg/socket/black neck cylinder, never draw a separate helmet. Keep the ORIGINAL helmet size relative to shoulders and face detail from input 2: low blue central crest, gold-trimmed silver swept side plates, luminous narrow cyan eyes, broad smooth ivory face mask, pointed chin. No new tall rear horns, no beak, no skeletal mouth, no enlarged headdress. Keep head orientation near original front-right 3/4 rather than extreme profile, even while torso rotates. Original rich cobalt, silver and narrow gold trim; preserve chest breastplate and long blue/black/gold cape design.

The approved long broad greatsword will be composed as a rigid asset after this body sheet. Draw ONLY a short straight black cylindrical handle gripped by the right hand, aligned with that hand and wrist; no blade or gold guard, no glow or VFX. The hand wraps firmly and naturally around the short handle. The handle is a positioning guide, not a second weapon.
TOP LEFT: grounded ready stance close to original standing, right sword-hand lowered forward; handle axis down-right about 43 degrees from horizontal.
TOP RIGHT: low forward dash to the right, trunk leaning moderately, left knee forward and right leg pushing, trailing cape. Keep face visible looking right. Right fist carries the handle behind and slightly down to the left, future blade axis points LEFT at 166 degrees; wrist and knuckles align for that grip.
BOTTOM LEFT: powerful horizontal sword-slash preparation, feet wide and grounded, torso coils left, sword-hand pulled to left side at lower-chest height; short grip axis up-right at -35 degrees. Head continues looking at target right.
BOTTOM RIGHT: powerful broad horizontal slash follow-through, feet planted, body unwinds, right arm extends forward at chest height, future blade axis RIGHT at +4 degrees; sturdy wrist aligned with hilt. Visible head and face must retain original helmet shape, no flattening or shrinking. Left hand counterbalances.
Art: very high detail game sprite, polished same painted metallic finish as original. NO labels, grid lines, text, floor, shadow plane, background, detached parts, extra limbs, blue sword, generated blade. Preserve actual transparency.
